srd-2024_barbarian-class.Rage: Bonus Action (no Heavy armor): Resistance to B/P/S, +Rage Damage on Str attacks, Adv. on Str checks/saves; no spells or Concentration. Lasts to end of next turn; extend by attacking, forcing a save, or a Bonus Action (max 10 min).
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Unarmored Defense: No armor: AC = 10 + Dex mod + Con mod (Shield allowed).
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Weapon Mastery: Use the mastery properties of your chosen weapon kinds (count per Barbarian table); swap one after a Long Rest.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Danger Sense: Advantage on Dex saves unless Incapacitated.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Reckless Attack: On your first attack of the turn: Adv. on Str attacks until your next turn, but attacks against you have Adv.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Primal Knowledge: Gain one Barbarian skill. While Raging, Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks can use Str.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Extra Attack: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Instinctive Pounce: Move up to half your Speed as part of the Bonus Action to Rage.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Brutal Strike: With Reckless Attack, forgo Adv. on one Str attack: on a hit +1d10 damage plus Forceful Blow (push 15 ft, follow half Speed) or Hamstring Blow (-15 ft Speed).
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Relentless Rage: Drop to 0 HP while Raging: DC 10 Con save (+5 each use, resets on a rest) to go to 2x Barbarian level HP instead.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Improved Brutal Strike: Brutal Strike adds Staggering Blow (Disadv. on next save, no Opportunity Attacks) and Sundering Blow (next ally attack +5). Level 17: 2d10 and two effects per strike.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Persistent Rage: Once per Long Rest, regain all Rage uses when you roll Initiative. Rage lasts 10 min; ends early only if Unconscious or in Heavy armor.
srd-2024_barbarian-class.Indomitable Might: A Str check or save total below your Str score uses the score instead.

srd-2024_path-of-the-berserker-subclass.Frenzy: Raging + Reckless Attack: first Str hit each turn deals extra d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.
srd-2024_path-of-the-berserker-subclass.Mindless Rage: Immune to Charmed and Frightened while Raging; entering Rage ends them.
srd-2024_path-of-the-berserker-subclass.Retaliation: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft damages you: make one melee attack against it.
srd-2024_path-of-the-berserker-subclass.Intimidating Presence: Bonus Action: creatures of your choice in 30 ft make a Wis save (DC 8 + Str + PB) or are Frightened 1 min (repeat save each turn). 1/Long Rest, or spend a Rage use.

srd-2024_bard-class.Bardic Inspiration: Bonus Action: a creature within 60 ft gains your Bardic die (d6; d8 at 5, d10 at 10, d12 at 15) to add to a failed D20 Test within 1 hour. Uses = Cha mod (min 1) per Long Rest.
srd-2024_bard-class.Spellcasting: Cha-based. Cantrips, prepared spells, and slots per the Bard table; swap a cantrip or spell on level-up. Focus: Musical Instrument.
srd-2024_bard-class.Expertise: Expertise in two proficient skills; two more at level 9.
srd-2024_bard-class.Jack of All Trades: Add half PB (round down) to ability checks with skills you lack proficiency in.
srd-2024_bard-class.Font of Inspiration: Bardic Inspiration recovers on a Short or Long Rest; spend a spell slot to regain a use.
srd-2024_bard-class.Countercharm: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 ft fails a save vs. Charmed/Frightened: reroll with Advantage.
srd-2024_bard-class.Magical Secrets: New prepared spells can come from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists (they count as Bard spells).
srd-2024_bard-class.Superior Inspiration: Roll Initiative: regain Bardic Inspiration up to 2 uses.
srd-2024_bard-class.Words of Creation: Always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared; each can also target a second creature within 10 ft of the first.

srd-2024_college-of-lore-subclass.Bonus Proficiencies: Gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.
srd-2024_college-of-lore-subclass.Cutting Words: Reaction when a creature within 60 ft makes a damage roll or succeeds on a check/attack: spend Bardic Inspiration, subtract the roll.
srd-2024_college-of-lore-subclass.Magical Discoveries: Learn two always-prepared spells from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists (cantrips or levels you can cast); swap one on level-up.
srd-2024_college-of-lore-subclass.Peerless Skill: Fail a check or attack: spend Bardic Inspiration and add it to the d20; not spent if it still fails.

srd-2024_cleric-class.Spellcasting: Wis-based. Cantrips, prepared spells, and slots per the Cleric table; change prepared spells after a Long Rest. Focus: Holy Symbol.
srd-2024_cleric-class.Divine Order: Choose Protector (Martial weapons, Heavy armor) or Thaumaturge (+1 cantrip; add Wis mod, min +1, to Arcana/Religion checks).
srd-2024_cleric-class.Channel Divinity: Uses per Cleric table (1 back on Short Rest, all on Long). Divine Spark: Magic action, 30 ft, heal or deal (Con save half) Necrotic/Radiant 1d8 + Wis (more d8s at 7/13/18). Turn Undead: Undead within 30 ft Wis save or Frightened + Incapacitated 1 min.
srd-2024_cleric-class.Sear Undead: Turn Undead also deals Radiant damage (Wis mod d8s, min 1) to each Undead that fails.
srd-2024_cleric-class.Blessed Strikes: Choose Divine Strike (1/turn weapon hit +1d8 Necrotic or Radiant) or Potent Spellcasting (+Wis mod to Cleric cantrip damage).
srd-2024_cleric-class.Divine Intervention: 1/Long Rest, Magic action: cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower (no Reaction spells) without a slot or Material components.
srd-2024_cleric-class.Improved Blessed Strikes: Divine Strike becomes 2d8, or Potent Spellcasting: a damaging Cleric cantrip grants 2x Wis mod Temp HP to you or a creature within 60 ft.
srd-2024_cleric-class.Greater Divine Intervention: Divine Intervention can cast Wish; then it's unusable for 2d4 Long Rests.

srd-2024_life-domain-subclass.Disciple of Life: Slot-cast healing spells restore an extra 2 + slot level HP.
srd-2024_life-domain-subclass.Life Domain Spells: Always prepared: 3 Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration; 5 Mass Healing Word, Revivify; 7 Aura of Life, Death Ward; 9 Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds.
srd-2024_life-domain-subclass.Preserve Life: Channel Divinity, Magic action: divide 5x Cleric level HP among Bloodied creatures within 30 ft (no higher than half their max HP).
srd-2024_life-domain-subclass.Blessed Healer: After a slot-cast spell heals someone else, you regain 2 + slot level HP.
srd-2024_life-domain-subclass.Supreme Healing: Healing dice from your spells and Channel Divinity always roll their maximum.

srd-2024_druid-class.Spellcasting: Wis-based. Cantrips, prepared spells, and slots per the Druid table; change prepared spells after a Long Rest. Focus: Druidic Focus.
srd-2024_druid-class.Druidic: Know Druidic (hidden messages; DC 15 Investigation to spot). Speak with Animals always prepared.
srd-2024_druid-class.Primal Order: Choose Magician (+1 cantrip; add Wis mod, min +1, to Arcana/Nature checks) or Warden (Martial weapons, Medium armor).
srd-2024_druid-class.Wild Shape: Bonus Action: become a known Beast form for half Druid level hours; gain Temp HP = Druid level. Uses per Druid table (1 back on Short Rest). Max CR 1/4 no fly at 2, 1/2 at 4, 1 with fly at 8.
srd-2024_druid-class.Wild Companion: Magic action: spend a slot or Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar (Fey, no Material; lasts until Long Rest).
srd-2024_druid-class.Wild Resurgence: 1/turn with no Wild Shape uses: spend a slot to regain one. 1/Long Rest: spend a Wild Shape use for a level 1 slot.
srd-2024_druid-class.Elemental Fury: Choose Potent Spellcasting (+Wis mod to Druid cantrip damage) or Primal Strike (1/turn weapon or Beast hit +1d8 Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder).
srd-2024_druid-class.Improved Elemental Fury: Potent Spellcasting: Druid cantrips with 10+ ft range gain +300 ft. Primal Strike: 2d8.
srd-2024_druid-class.Beast Spells: Cast spells in Wild Shape, except ones with a costly or consumed Material component.
srd-2024_druid-class.Archdruid: Roll Initiative with no Wild Shape uses: regain one. 1/Long Rest: convert Wild Shape uses to a slot (2 levels each). Age 1 year per 10.

srd-2024_circle-of-the-land-subclass.Circle of the Land Spells: After each Long Rest, pick a land (arid, polar, temperate, tropical); that land's circle spells for your level are always prepared.
srd-2024_circle-of-the-land-subclass.Land's Aid: Magic action + Wild Shape use: 10-ft Sphere within 60 ft; chosen creatures Con save or 2d6 Necrotic (half on save), one creature heals 2d6 (3d6 at 10, 4d6 at 14).
srd-2024_circle-of-the-land-subclass.Natural Recovery: 1/Long Rest: cast a circle spell without a slot. 1/Long Rest on a Short Rest: recover slots totaling half Druid level (round up), none 6+.
srd-2024_circle-of-the-land-subclass.Nature's Ward: Immune to Poisoned; Resistance by land: arid Fire, polar Cold, temperate Lightning, tropical Poison.
srd-2024_circle-of-the-land-subclass.Nature's Sanctuary: Magic action + Wild Shape use: 15-ft Cube within 120 ft for 1 min; you and allies get Half Cover, allies gain your Nature's Ward Resistance. Bonus Action: move it 60 ft.

srd-2024_fighter-class.Second Wind: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP. Uses per Fighter table (1 back on Short Rest, all on Long).
srd-2024_fighter-class.Weapon Mastery: Use the mastery properties of your chosen weapon kinds (count per Fighter table); swap one after a Long Rest.
srd-2024_fighter-class.Action Surge: Take one extra action on your turn (not Magic). 1/Short or Long Rest; 2 uses from level 17 (one per turn).
srd-2024_fighter-class.Tactical Mind: Fail an ability check: spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10; not spent if it still fails.
srd-2024_fighter-class.Extra Attack: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
srd-2024_fighter-class.Tactical Shift: Using Second Wind lets you move half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
srd-2024_fighter-class.Indomitable: Reroll a failed save, adding your Fighter level; must use the new roll. 1/Long Rest (2 at 13, 3 at 17).
srd-2024_fighter-class.Tactical Master: When attacking with a mastery weapon, swap its property for Push, Sap, or Slow.
srd-2024_fighter-class.Two Extra Attacks: Attack three times when you take the Attack action.
srd-2024_fighter-class.Studied Attacks: Miss a creature: Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your next turn.
srd-2024_fighter-class.Three Extra Attacks: Attack four times when you take the Attack action.

srd-2024_champion-subclass.Improved Critical: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks crit on 19-20.
srd-2024_champion-subclass.Remarkable Athlete: Advantage on Initiative and Athletics checks; after a crit, move half your Speed without provoking.
srd-2024_champion-subclass.Heroic Warrior: In combat, gain Heroic Inspiration at the start of your turn if you don't have it.
srd-2024_champion-subclass.Superior Critical: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks crit on 18-20.
srd-2024_champion-subclass.Survivor: Advantage on Death Saves; 18-20 counts as a 20. While Bloodied (1+ HP), regain 5 + Con mod HP at the start of each turn.

srd-2024_monk-class.Martial Arts: Unarmed or Monk weapons, no armor/Shield: Bonus Action Unarmed Strike, Martial Arts die for damage, Dex for attack/damage and Grapple/Shove DC.
srd-2024_monk-class.Unarmored Defense: No armor or Shield: AC = 10 + Dex mod + Wis mod.
srd-2024_monk-class.Monk's Focus: Focus Points per Monk table (all back on a Short Rest); save DC 8 + Wis + PB. Flurry of Blows (1 FP: 2 Bonus Action strikes), Patient Defense (Disengage; 1 FP: + Dodge), Step of the Wind (Dash; 1 FP: + Disengage, double jump).
srd-2024_monk-class.Unarmored Movement: +Speed without armor or Shield (per Monk table).
srd-2024_monk-class.Uncanny Metabolism: 1/Long Rest on Initiative: regain all Focus Points and heal Monk level + Martial Arts die.
srd-2024_monk-class.Deflect Attacks: Reaction when hit by B/P/S: reduce damage by 1d10 + Dex + Monk level. At 0, 1 FP: redirect for 2 Martial Arts dice + Dex (Dex save).
srd-2024_monk-class.Slow Fall: Reaction: reduce falling damage by 5x Monk level.
srd-2024_monk-class.Extra Attack: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
srd-2024_monk-class.Stunning Strike: 1/turn on a Monk weapon/Unarmed hit, 1 FP: Con save or Stunned until your next turn; on a success, half Speed and the next attack on it has Adv.
srd-2024_monk-class.Empowered Strikes: Unarmed Strikes can deal Force damage.
srd-2024_monk-class.Evasion: Dex save for half damage: none on a success, half on a failure (not while Incapacitated).
srd-2024_monk-class.Acrobatic Movement: No armor or Shield: move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn.
srd-2024_monk-class.Heightened Focus: Flurry of Blows makes 3 strikes; Patient Defense (FP) grants 2 Martial Arts dice Temp HP; Step of the Wind (FP) carries a willing Large or smaller creature.
srd-2024_monk-class.Self-Restoration: End of your turn: end Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned on yourself. No Exhaustion from lack of food or drink.
srd-2024_monk-class.Deflect Energy: Deflect Attacks works against any damage type.
srd-2024_monk-class.Disciplined Survivor: Proficiency in all saves; 1 FP to reroll a failed save.
srd-2024_monk-class.Perfect Focus: On Initiative without Uncanny Metabolism, regain Focus Points up to 4.
srd-2024_monk-class.Superior Defense: Start of turn, 3 FP: Resistance to all damage but Force for 1 min.

srd-2024_warrior-of-the-open-hand-subcla.Open Hand Technique: Flurry of Blows hits can impose Addle (no Opportunity Attacks), Push (Str save or 15 ft), or Topple (Dex save or Prone).
srd-2024_warrior-of-the-open-hand-subcla.Wholeness of Body: Bonus Action: heal Martial Arts die + Wis mod (min 1). Wis mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.
srd-2024_warrior-of-the-open-hand-subcla.Fleet Step: After any other Bonus Action, also use Step of the Wind.
srd-2024_warrior-of-the-open-hand-subcla.Quivering Palm: Unarmed hit, 4 FP: vibrations last Monk level days. End them (action, or forgo an attack): Con save, 10d12 Force (half on save).

srd-2024_paladin-class.Lay On Hands: Bonus Action touch: heal from a pool of 5x Paladin level HP (refills on Long Rest); 5 HP from the pool removes Poisoned.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Spellcasting: Cha-based. Prepared spells and slots per the Paladin table; swap one spell after a Long Rest. Focus: Holy Symbol.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Weapon Mastery: Use the mastery properties of two weapon kinds you're proficient with; change them after a Long Rest.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Paladin's Smite: Divine Smite always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Channel Divinity: 2 uses (3 at 11); 1 back on Short Rest, all on Long. Divine Sense: Bonus Action, 10 min, sense Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 ft.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Extra Attack: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Faithful Steed: Find Steed always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Aura of Protection: You and allies within 10 ft add your Cha mod (min +1) to saves. Inactive while Incapacitated.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Abjure Foes: Channel Divinity, Magic action: Cha mod creatures (min 1) within 60 ft Wis save or Frightened 1 min (ends on damage); they can only move, act, or Bonus Action.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Aura of Courage: You and allies in your aura are immune to Frightened.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Radiant Strikes: Melee weapon and Unarmed Strike hits deal +1d8 Radiant.
srd-2024_paladin-class.Restoring Touch: Lay On Hands can also remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned (5 HP from the pool each).

srd-2024_oath-of-devotion-subclass.Oath of Devotion Spells: Always prepared: 3 Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith; 5 Aid, Zone of Truth; 9 Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic; 13 Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith; 17 Commune, Flame Strike.
srd-2024_oath-of-devotion-subclass.Sacred Weapon: Channel Divinity on the Attack action: a held melee weapon adds Cha mod (min +1) to attacks, can deal Radiant, and sheds light, for 10 min.
srd-2024_oath-of-devotion-subclass.Aura of Devotion: You and allies in your aura are immune to Charmed.
srd-2024_oath-of-devotion-subclass.Smite of Protection: Casting Divine Smite gives you and allies in your aura Half Cover until your next turn.
srd-2024_oath-of-devotion-subclass.Holy Nimbus: 1/Long Rest (or a level 5 slot), Bonus Action, 10 min: Adv. on saves forced by Fiends/Undead; enemies starting their turn in the aura take Cha + PB Radiant; aura is sunlight.

srd-2024_ranger-class.Spellcasting: Wis-based. Prepared spells and slots per the Ranger table; swap one spell after a Long Rest. Focus: Druidic Focus.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Favored Enemy: Hunter's Mark always prepared; cast it without a slot a number of times per the Ranger table (per Long Rest).
srd-2024_ranger-class.Weapon Mastery: Use the mastery properties of two weapon kinds you're proficient with; change them after a Long Rest.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Deft Explorer: Expertise in one proficient skill; learn two languages.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Extra Attack: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Roving: +10 ft Speed without Heavy armor; Climb and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Expertise: Expertise in two more proficient skills.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Tireless: Magic action: gain 1d8 + Wis mod Temp HP, Wis mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest. A Short Rest reduces Exhaustion by 1.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Relentless Hunter: Damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Nature's Veil: Bonus Action: Invisible until the end of your next turn. Wis mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Precise Hunter: Advantage on attacks against the target of your Hunter's Mark.
srd-2024_ranger-class.Foe Slayer: Hunter's Mark damage die becomes a d10.

srd-2024_hunter-subclass.Hunter's Lore: You know the Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities of your Hunter's Mark target.
srd-2024_hunter-subclass.Hunter's Prey: Choose (swap on a rest) Colossus Slayer (1/turn +1d8 weapon damage to a damaged target) or Horde Breaker (1/turn extra attack on a different creature within 5 ft of the first).
srd-2024_hunter-subclass.Defensive Tactics: Choose (swap on a rest) Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadv.) or Multiattack Defense (a creature that hits you has Disadv. on its other attacks this turn).
srd-2024_hunter-subclass.Superior Hunter's Prey: 1/turn when you damage your Hunter's Mark target, deal the Mark's damage to another creature within 30 ft of it.
srd-2024_hunter-subclass.Superior Hunter's Defense: Reaction when you take damage: Resistance to that type until end of turn.

srd-2024_rogue-class.Expertise: Expertise in two proficient skills; two more at level 6.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Sneak Attack: 1/turn: +Sneak Attack dice on a Finesse/Ranged hit with Advantage, or with an ally within 5 ft of the target (and no Disadvantage).
srd-2024_rogue-class.Thieves' Cant: Know Thieves' Cant and one other language.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Weapon Mastery: Use the mastery properties of two weapon kinds you're proficient with; change them after a Long Rest.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Cunning Action: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Steady Aim: Bonus Action if you haven't moved: Advantage on your next attack this turn; Speed 0 until turn ends.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Cunning Strike: Forgo Sneak Attack dice for an effect (DC 8 + Dex + PB): Poison (1d6, Con save or Poisoned; needs Poisoner's Kit), Trip (1d6, Dex save or Prone), Withdraw (1d6, move half Speed without provoking).
srd-2024_rogue-class.Uncanny Dodge: Reaction when an attacker you see hits you: halve the damage.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Evasion: Dex save for half damage: none on a success, half on a failure (not while Incapacitated).
srd-2024_rogue-class.Reliable Talent: Checks with a skill or tool proficiency treat a d20 of 9 or lower as 10.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Improved Cunning Strike: Use up to two Cunning Strike effects per Sneak Attack.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Devious Strikes: New Cunning Strikes: Daze (2d6, Con save or only move/act/Bonus Action), Obscure (3d6, Dex save or Blinded), Knock Out (6d6, Con save or Unconscious 1 min).
srd-2024_rogue-class.Slippery Mind: Proficiency in Wis and Cha saves.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Elusive: No attack roll has Advantage against you unless you're Incapacitated.
srd-2024_rogue-class.Stroke of Luck: Turn a failed D20 Test into a 20. 1/Short or Long Rest.

srd-2024_thief-subclass.Fast Hands: Bonus Action: Sleight of Hand (lock, trap, pocket), Utilize, or use a magic item's Magic action.
srd-2024_thief-subclass.Second-Story Work: Climb Speed equal to Speed; use Dex for jump distance.
srd-2024_thief-subclass.Supreme Sneak: Cunning Strike Stealth Attack (1d6): stay Invisible from Hide if you end the turn behind 3/4 or Total Cover.
srd-2024_thief-subclass.Use Magic Device: Attune up to 4 items; on a 6 (1d6) a charge isn't spent; use any Spell Scroll (Int; Arcana DC 10 + level for level 2+).
srd-2024_thief-subclass.Thief's Reflexes: Take two turns in the first round of combat: at your Initiative and at Initiative - 10.

srd-2024_sorcerer-class.Spellcasting: Cha-based. Cantrips, prepared spells, and slots per the Sorcerer table; swap a cantrip or spell on level-up. Focus: Arcane Focus.
srd-2024_sorcerer-class.Innate Sorcery: Bonus Action, 1 min: Sorcerer spell save DC +1 and Advantage on Sorcerer spell attacks. 2 uses per Long Rest.
srd-2024_sorcerer-class.Font of Magic: Sorcery Points per Sorcerer table (Long Rest). Spend a slot for SP equal to its level; Bonus Action: SP into a slot (1st 2, 2nd 3, 3rd 5, 4th 6, 5th 7).
srd-2024_sorcerer-class.Metamagic: Know two Metamagic options (two more at 10 and 17); spend Sorcery Points to modify a spell, one option per spell.
srd-2024_sorcerer-class.Sorcerous Restoration: 1/Long Rest on a Short Rest: regain Sorcery Points up to half Sorcerer level.
srd-2024_sorcerer-class.Sorcery Incarnate: Spend 2 SP to use Innate Sorcery with no uses left; while it's active, use two Metamagic options per spell.
srd-2024_sorcerer-class.Arcane Apotheosis: While Innate Sorcery is active, one Metamagic per turn costs no Sorcery Points.

srd-2024_draconic-sorcery-subclass.Draconic Resilience: +3 max HP, +1 per later Sorcerer level. No armor: AC = 10 + Dex mod + Cha mod.
srd-2024_draconic-sorcery-subclass.Draconic Spells: Always prepared: 3 Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath; 5 Fear, Fly; 7 Arcane Eye, Charm Monster; 9 Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.
srd-2024_draconic-sorcery-subclass.Elemental Affinity: Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison: Resistance to it, and add Cha mod to one damage roll of spells dealing it.
srd-2024_draconic-sorcery-subclass.Dragon Wings: Bonus Action: Fly Speed 60 ft for 1 hour. 1/Long Rest, or spend 3 Sorcery Points.
srd-2024_draconic-sorcery-subclass.Dragon Companion: Summon Dragon needs no Material; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, optionally without Concentration (1 min).

srd-2024_dragonborn-species.Draconic Ancestry: Your dragon type sets your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance damage type.
srd-2024_dragonborn-species.Breath Weapon: Replace an attack: 15-ft Cone or 30-ft Line, Dex save (DC 8 + Con + PB), 1d10 of your ancestry type, half on save (2d10 at 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17). PB uses per Long Rest.
srd-2024_dragonborn-species.Damage Resistance: Resistance to your Draconic Ancestry damage type.
srd-2024_dragonborn-species.Draconic Flight: Level 5+, 1/Long Rest, Bonus Action: Fly Speed equal to Speed for 10 min.

srd-2024_dwarf-species.Dwarven Resilience: Resistance to Poison damage; Advantage on saves vs. Poisoned.
srd-2024_dwarf-species.Stonecunning: Bonus Action: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 min while on or touching stone. PB uses per Long Rest.

srd-2024_elf-species.Elven Lineage: Your lineage grants a level 1 benefit and spells at levels 3 and 5 (always prepared, each castable 1/Long Rest without a slot). Int, Wis, or Cha casting.
srd-2024_elf-species.Keen Senses: Proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.
srd-2024_elf-species.Trance: Don't need sleep and can't be magically slept; Long Rest in 4 hours of trance.

srd-2024_gnome-species.Gnomish Cunning: Advantage on Int, Wis, and Cha saves.
srd-2024_gnome-species.Gnomish Lineage: Forest Gnome: Minor Illusion; Speak with Animals PB times per Long Rest. Rock Gnome: Mending, Prestidigitation; build Tiny clockwork devices. Int, Wis, or Cha casting.

srd-2024_goliath-species.Giant Ancestry: Your chosen giant boon, PB uses per Long Rest: Cloud's Jaunt (teleport 30 ft), Fire's Burn (+1d10 Fire), Frost's Chill (+1d6 Cold, -10 ft Speed), Hill's Tumble (Prone), Stone's Endurance (reduce damage 1d12 + Con), or Storm's Thunder (1d8 Thunder to attacker).
srd-2024_goliath-species.Large Form: Level 5+, 1/Long Rest, Bonus Action: become Large for 10 min; Advantage on Str checks, +10 ft Speed.
srd-2024_goliath-species.Powerful Build: Advantage on checks to end Grappled; count one size larger for carrying capacity.

srd-2024_halfling-species.Halfling Nimbleness: Move through the space of any creature larger than you (can't stop there).
srd-2024_halfling-species.Luck: Reroll a 1 on a D20 Test; must use the new roll.
srd-2024_halfling-species.Naturally Stealthy: Hide when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.

srd-2024_human-species.Resourceful: Gain Heroic Inspiration after each Long Rest.
srd-2024_human-species.Skillful: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.
srd-2024_human-species.Versatile: Gain an Origin feat of your choice.

srd-2024_orc-species.Adrenaline Rush: Bonus Action Dash and gain PB Temp HP. PB uses per Short or Long Rest.
srd-2024_orc-species.Relentless Endurance: 1/Long Rest: drop to 1 HP instead of 0 (unless killed outright).

srd-2024_tiefling-species.Fiendish Legacy: Your legacy grants a level 1 benefit and spells at levels 3 and 5 (always prepared, each castable 1/Long Rest without a slot). Int, Wis, or Cha casting.
srd-2024_tiefling-species.Otherworldly Presence: Know Thaumaturgy (uses your Fiendish Legacy ability).

feats.Alert: Add PB to Initiative. After rolling Initiative, you can swap it with a willing ally's.
feats.Magic Initiate: Two cantrips and one always-prepared level 1 spell from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list; cast the spell 1/Long Rest without a slot. Int, Wis, or Cha.
feats.Savage Attacker: 1/turn on a weapon hit, roll the damage dice twice and use either roll.
feats.Skilled: Proficiency in any three skills or tools.
feats.Grappler: +1 Str or Dex. Unarmed Strike can damage and Grapple (1/turn); Advantage vs. creatures you Grapple; move them at no extra cost.
feats.Archery: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.
feats.Great Weapon Fighting: Two-handed melee (Two-Handed or Versatile): treat 1s and 2s on damage dice as 3s.
feats.Two-Weapon Fighting: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the Light weapon extra attack.
feats.Boon of Combat Prowess: +1 to one ability (max 30). Turn a missed attack into a hit, once per turn.
feats.Boon of Dimensional Travel: +1 to one ability (max 30). After an Attack or Magic action, teleport 30 ft.
feats.Boon of Fate: +1 to one ability (max 30). Add or subtract 2d4 to a D20 Test within 60 ft; recharges on Initiative or a rest.
feats.Boon of Irresistible Offense: +1 Str or Dex (max 30). Your B/P/S damage ignores Resistance; on a natural 20, extra damage equal to that score.
feats.Boon of Spell Recall: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 30). Casting with a level 1-4 slot: roll 1d4; if it equals the slot level, the slot isn't spent.
feats.Boon of the Night Spirit: +1 to one ability (max 30). In Dim Light or Darkness: Bonus Action Invisible (ends when you act); Resistance to all but Psychic and Radiant.

srd-2024_warlock-class.Eldritch Invocations: Know invocations per the Warlock table (meet prerequisites); swap one on level-up.
srd-2024_warlock-class.Pact Magic: Cha-based. Cantrips, prepared spells, and slots per the Warlock table; all slots are the same level and recover on a Short or Long Rest. Focus: Arcane Focus.
srd-2024_warlock-class.Magical Cunning: 1/Long Rest, 1-minute rite: regain Pact Magic slots up to half your maximum (round up).
srd-2024_warlock-class.Contact Patron: Contact Other Plane always prepared; 1/Long Rest cast it without a slot and automatically succeed on its save.
srd-2024_warlock-class.Mystic Arcanum: One Warlock spell each of level 6 (and 7 at 13, 8 at 15, 9 at 17) castable once per Long Rest without a slot.
srd-2024_warlock-class.Eldritch Master: Magical Cunning regains all Pact Magic slots.

srd-2024_fiend-patron-subclass.Dark One's Blessing: Reduce an enemy to 0 HP (or an ally does within 10 ft of you): gain Cha mod + Warlock level Temp HP (min 1).
srd-2024_fiend-patron-subclass.Fiend Spells: Always prepared: 3 Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion; 5 Fireball, Stinking Cloud; 7 Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; 9 Geas, Insect Plague.
srd-2024_fiend-patron-subclass.Dark One's Own Luck: Add 1d10 to an ability check or save after seeing the roll. Cha mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest, once per roll.
srd-2024_fiend-patron-subclass.Fiendish Resilience: After a Short or Long Rest, choose a damage type other than Force: Resistance to it.
srd-2024_fiend-patron-subclass.Hurl Through Hell: 1/turn on an attack hit: Cha save (spell DC) or 8d10 Psychic (non-Fiends) and Incapacitated until end of your next turn. 1/Long Rest, or spend a Pact slot.

srd-2024_wizard-class.Spellcasting: Int-based. Cantrips, prepared spells (from your spellbook), and slots per the Wizard table; add two spells to the book per level. Focus: Arcane Focus or spellbook.
srd-2024_wizard-class.Ritual Adept: Cast any Ritual spell in your spellbook as a Ritual without preparing it.
srd-2024_wizard-class.Arcane Recovery: 1/Long Rest on a Short Rest: recover slots totaling half Wizard level (round up), none 6+.
srd-2024_wizard-class.Scholar: Expertise in one proficient skill: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion.
srd-2024_wizard-class.Memorize Spell: After a Short Rest, swap one prepared level 1+ spell for another in your spellbook.
srd-2024_wizard-class.Spell Mastery: A chosen level 1 and level 2 spellbook spell (Action casting time) are always prepared and castable at their base level without a slot.
srd-2024_wizard-class.Signature Spells: Two level 3 spellbook spells are always prepared; cast each once at level 3 without a slot per Short or Long Rest.

srd-2024_evoker-subclass.Evocation Savant: Add two level 2 or lower Evocation spells to your spellbook free, plus one free Evocation spell each time you gain a new slot level.
srd-2024_evoker-subclass.Potent Cantrip: A damaging cantrip that misses or is saved against still deals half damage (no other effect).
srd-2024_evoker-subclass.Sculpt Spells: Evocation spells: 1 + spell level creatures you see auto-succeed on the save and take no damage on a half-damage save.
srd-2024_evoker-subclass.Empowered Evocation: Add Int mod to one damage roll of Wizard Evocation spells.
srd-2024_evoker-subclass.Overchannel: Deal max damage with a level 1-5 Wizard spell. First use per Long Rest is free; each later one deals 2d12 (then +1d12) Necrotic per slot level to you.

options.Eldritch Invocations|Agonizing Blast: Add Cha mod to the damage of one chosen damaging Warlock cantrip (repeatable, different cantrip).
options.Eldritch Invocations|Armor of Shadows: Cast Mage Armor on yourself at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Ascendant Step: Cast Levitate on yourself at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Devil's Sight: See normally in Dim Light and Darkness (magical too) within 120 ft.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Devouring Blade: Thirsting Blade grants two extra attacks instead of one.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Eldritch Mind: Advantage on Con saves to maintain Concentration.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Eldritch Smite: 1/turn on a pact weapon hit, spend a Pact slot: +1d8 Force + 1d8 per slot level, and knock Huge or smaller Prone.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Eldritch Spear: One chosen damaging Warlock cantrip (10+ ft range) gains 30 ft x Warlock level range.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Fiendish Vigor: Cast False Life on yourself at will, no slot; take the max Temp HP.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Gaze of Two Minds: Bonus Action: touch a willing creature and use its senses until your next turn (maintain each turn); cast from its space within 60 ft.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Gift of the Depths: Breathe underwater; Swim Speed equals Speed; Water Breathing 1/Long Rest without a slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Gift of the Protect: Cha mod names in your Book of Shadows: the first to drop to 0 HP goes to 1 HP instead, 1/Long Rest.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Investment of the C: Familiar: 40 ft Fly or Swim, Bonus Action Attack, Necrotic/Radiant damage, your spell DC, Reaction resistance.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Lessons of the Firs: Gain one Origin feat (repeatable, different feat).
options.Eldritch Invocations|Lifedrinker: 1/turn on a pact weapon hit: +1d6 Necrotic/Psychic/Radiant; spend a Hit Die to heal it + Con mod.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Mask of Many Faces: Cast Disguise Self at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Master of Myriad Fo: Cast Alter Self at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Misty Visions: Cast Silent Image at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|One with Shadows: In Dim Light or Darkness, cast Invisibility on yourself at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Otherworldly Leap: Cast Jump on yourself at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Pact of the Blade: Bonus Action: conjure or bond a melee pact weapon; proficient, use Cha for attack and damage, can deal Necrotic/Psychic/Radiant; it is a spellcasting focus.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Pact of the Chain: Find Familiar at will as a Magic action (special forms: Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Skeleton, Sphinx of Wonder, Sprite, Venomous Snake); forgo an attack so it attacks.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Pact of the Tome: Book of Shadows: 3 cantrips and 2 level 1 Ritual spells from any list, prepared while you carry it; it is a spellcasting focus.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Repelling Blast: Hits with one chosen Warlock attack cantrip push Large or smaller 10 ft.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Thirsting Blade: Attack twice with your pact weapon on the Attack action.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Visions of Distant: Cast Arcane Eye at will, no slot.
options.Eldritch Invocations|Whispers of the Gra: Cast Speak with Dead at will, no slot.
options.Metamagic|Careful Spell: 1 SP: up to Cha mod creatures auto-succeed on the spell's save and take no damage on a half-damage save.
options.Metamagic|Distant Spell: 1 SP: double a 5+ ft range, or make Touch 30 ft.
options.Metamagic|Empowered Spell: 1 SP: reroll up to Cha mod damage dice (stacks with another option).
options.Metamagic|Extended Spell: 1 SP: double a 1+ minute duration (max 24 hours); Adv. on its Concentration saves.
options.Metamagic|Heightened Spell: 2 SP: one target has Disadvantage on saves against the spell.
options.Metamagic|Quickened Spell: 2 SP: an Action spell becomes a Bonus Action (no other level 1+ spell this turn).
options.Metamagic|Seeking Spell: 1 SP: reroll a missed spell attack (stacks with another option).
options.Metamagic|Subtle Spell: 1 SP: no Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.
options.Metamagic|Transmuted Spell: 1 SP: change Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage to another of them.
options.Metamagic|Twinned Spell: 1 SP: raise the spell's effective level by 1 (for spells that add targets with higher slots).
options.Divine Order|Thaumaturge: +1 Cleric cantrip; add Wis mod (min +1) to Arcana and Religion checks.
options.Primal Order|Magician: +1 Druid cantrip; add Wis mod (min +1) to Arcana and Nature checks.
options.Blessed Strikes|Divine Strike: 1/turn weapon hit: +1d8 Necrotic or Radiant (2d8 at 14).
options.Blessed Strikes|Potent Spellcasting: +Wis mod to Cleric cantrip damage (at 14: damaging cantrip grants 2x Wis Temp HP).
options.Elemental Fury|Potent Spellcasting: +Wis mod to Druid cantrip damage (at 15: +300 ft range).
options.Elemental Fury|Primal Strike: 1/turn weapon or Beast hit: +1d8 Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder (2d8 at 15).
options.Hunter's Prey|Colossus Slayer: 1/turn weapon hit: +1d8 to a target missing HP.
options.Hunter's Prey|Horde Breaker: 1/turn: extra attack with the same weapon on a different creature within 5 ft of the first.
options.Defensive Tactics|Escape the Horde: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
options.Defensive Tactics|Multiattack Defense: A creature that hits you has Disadv. on its other attacks against you this turn.
options.Giant Ancestry|Cloud's Jaunt: Bonus Action: teleport 30 ft. PB uses per Long Rest.
options.Giant Ancestry|Fire's Burn: On an attack hit, +1d10 Fire. PB uses per Long Rest.
options.Giant Ancestry|Frost's Chill: On an attack hit, +1d6 Cold and -10 ft Speed. PB uses per Long Rest.
options.Giant Ancestry|Hill's Tumble: On an attack hit vs Large or smaller: Prone. PB uses per Long Rest.
options.Giant Ancestry|Stone's Endurance: Reaction when damaged: reduce by 1d12 + Con mod. PB uses per Long Rest.
options.Giant Ancestry|Storm's Thunder: Reaction when damaged by a creature within 60 ft: 1d8 Thunder to it. PB uses per Long Rest.
options.Gnomish Lineage|Forest Gnome: Minor Illusion; Speak with Animals PB times per Long Rest without a slot.
options.Gnomish Lineage|Rock Gnome: Mending and Prestidigitation; build up to 3 Tiny clockwork devices (10 min each).
options.Circle of the Land Spells|Arid: Arid land spells prepared; Nature's Ward: Fire.
options.Circle of the Land Spells|Polar: Polar land spells prepared; Nature's Ward: Cold.
options.Circle of the Land Spells|Temperate: Temperate land spells prepared; Nature's Ward: Lightning.
options.Circle of the Land Spells|Tropical: Tropical land spells prepared; Nature's Ward: Poison.
options.Elemental Affinity|Acid: Resistance to Acid; add Cha mod to one damage roll of Acid spells.
options.Elemental Affinity|Cold: Resistance to Cold; add Cha mod to one damage roll of Cold spells.
options.Elemental Affinity|Fire: Resistance to Fire; add Cha mod to one damage roll of Fire spells.
options.Elemental Affinity|Lightning: Resistance to Lightning; add Cha mod to one damage roll of Lightning spells.
options.Elemental Affinity|Poison: Resistance to Poison; add Cha mod to one damage roll of Poison spells.
